notes.title: (Promo) OKJOY's "Cavalry Girls" shooter game is now live!
notes.notes:
Published by OKJOY, the light Rogue mech-girl top-down shooter "Cavalry Girls" is set to officially launch on the Steam platform at 01:00 Pacific Time today (October 20th)! The game has a total playtime of over 20 hours!

Store page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2055050/_/?utm_source=tonggao&utm_campaign=shoufa

[h3]Game Introduction:[/h3]
Cavalry Girls is a light roguelike top-down shooter indie game. In this game, players will lead Cavalry Girls into battles against enemy forces. Modify various mecha models, strategically deploy mechas with different skills, repel the overwhelming enemies, and defend your empire amid the raging fires. With limited supplies, players will have to make wise resource allocations, manage soldiers and survive on an increasingly intense battlefield.

[h3]Game Featured[/h3]
[b]
Top-Down Shooting[/b]

- Experience the authentic shooting feel and enjoy the thrilling battlefield.
- A plethora of equipment modules to choose from, with each weapon offering distinct effects.
- Engage in rogue-like combat against dozens of enemy types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458630/da19247ff2bf6466bd226ca5d72d91175477b64a.gif[/img]
[b]
Strategic Deployment[/b]

- Choose your favorite equipment and teammates and pick modules to build the most powerful mecha.
- Gather intelligence for strategic deployment and strike enemies based on their unique characteristics.
- Make decisions using limited resources - take risks or play it safe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458630/82762e0d6f028ec0da94c5d734abab766a52bebb.gif[/img]

[b]Casual Gameplay[/b]

- Five recruitable characters with distinct personalities. Choose your favorite Cavalry Girls to accompany you in battle.
- Arrange cozy dorms for Cavalry Girls and give them gifts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458630/a8e869f4ba3bf18ca467dff232593b444f7f7bc5.gif[/img]

notes.title: Dire Destiny : Time Travel New Characters Revealed!
notes.notes:
Greetings, heroes! Today, "Dire Destiny: Time Travel" welcomes two new charming characters - the Mechanic and the Lady Gambler. They have joined this fantastic and adventurous steampunk world, ready to embark on a mysterious journey with you!
[b]
Mech Pilot[/b]
This thrill-seeking adventurer fights alongside her machines, constantly strengthening the connection between her and her machinery until they become one. She truly feels the excitement of life when piloting her mech suit. Brave and decisive, she will lend you a hand on the battlefield and face challenges together!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41777926/d0939b28d7794b28957be6e4fef51d22ceb16926.png[/img]

[b]Gambler[/b]
An adventurer who embraces nihilism. The Gambler lives on the edge between life and death, attempting to make the elusive possibilities work in her favor. Her never-ending greed prevents her from enjoying what she has already obtained.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41777926/b8ded1b16902b65723de1b5ad28f0f83f29c1251.png[/img]

The addition of these two new characters brings more strategic elements and challenges to the game. Step into the steampunk world now and experience the thrilling adventures brought by these new characters!

notes.title: Dire Destiny: Time Travel Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Roguelike Strategy Card Game "Dire Destiny: Time Travel" is Now Available on Both Mobile and PC! 

"Dire Destiny: Time Travel" officially launched on mobile and PC platforms at 10:30 AM on April 18th(GMT+8)/ 07:30 PM on April 17(PDT) The game is free to download, with characters available for purchase to unlock, and no in-game purchases for attributes or appearances.
Steam store page: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1861090/_/

In the once-thriving steam city, fight against the endless army of machines, set the gears of history right, and save humanity's ultimate destiny.
Welcome, players summoned from different timelines to the age of Steam!


[b]Background[/b]
This is a world in the steam age. Iron and Magic coexist here. As the machines were becoming more and more powerful, they started an organized attack on the human race. One day in the future, mankind will face the fate of extinction caused by the mechanized army. Heroes from different time-space are summoned by an emissary who called himself ‘The protector of mankind’. They collected forces and were determined to defeat the mechanized monsters, so as to prevent the tragic extinction of mankind from happening.
Under the thick smoke of mystery, a long-brewing conspiracy slowly begins…

[b]Game Features[/b]
Steam plus Gears plus Rivets equals Steampunk!
Here, you can see magic elements such as constellations and Gods, which are contained in the architecture. You can also have a view of Steampunk buildings from the Victorian period in the 19th century. All of the settings are closely combined with the story of the game, building an empathy engagement in the scenes and giving players an immersive experience.


[b]Over 100 Combinations of Cards![/b]
Players can collect cards in many ways and sift through them by making different combinations. During the combats, players can also use the combos to secure victory.

[b]
More Combos of Cards’ Skills at Your Decision![/b]
Here, you’ll have an original fusion system of cards. When you arrive at a designated location, you can make a custom combo of the cards you own. Different skills from the two cards will start to fuse together, adding more creative tactics as well as continuous variations of combat experience!


[b]Complicated and Confusing Random Events Continue to Occur…[/b]
There are mechanisms of Adventures and Treasures that can be triggered on your journey by chance. If you accomplish the random missions in Adventures, you’ll get rewards such as more cards, and more buffs. Or you can get the cards you need and gold coins from the machine shop.
